text:
david: starting deploy for llm-router v2.6.0 with quantized kernels enabled. change window: 03:00-05:00 UTC. Feature flag `llmroute_quantize_enable` will gate the quantized path. rollout plan: canary -> 5% (20m) -> 25% (30m) -> 75% next window. release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.6.0

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy queued service=llm-router version=v2.6.0 by david. Canary stage will run in internal env then prod. Manual approvals required at each ramp.

megan: holdpoint: keep 5% for full 20m. gating metrics: p95 latency delta < 120ms, model output match rate > 98% (semantic eval), 5xx < 0.5%. If match < 97% OR p95 delta > 200ms => immediate disable.

david: added pin to deploy manifest: `model_pin = \"v2.6-quant\"` for cohorts on flag=true. We'll unpin after 24h soak if stable.

ops-bot: Runbook reminder: fast-disable commands available in ops toolbox. 1) full disable: ```/deploybot flag disable llmroute_quantize_enable``` 2) step-back to safe mode: ```/deploybot flag set llmroute_quantize_enable 0``` 3) pin back to baseline: ```/deploybot config set route.model_pin v2.5-stable``` See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quantize-rollback

sre-oncall: infra watch up. Preflight OK. Setting auto-rollback watches: if p95 > 350ms OR 5xx > 1% for 3m -> auto-disable flag and pin to v2.5-stable. Also watch GPU memory pressure on quant pods; if memory > 85% for 2m -> pause ramp and alert.

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_quantize_enable` -> true in internal-canary (QA override 100%) by david.

megan: internal smoke (6m): semantic eval pass rate 99.1%, p95 delta +18ms, no 5xx. :thumbsup:

david: /approve initial prod 5% ramp at +15m if gates hold.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: ramp `llmroute_quantize_enable` -> 5% at +15m (manual approval recorded).

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_quantize_enable` -> 5% by david.

carmen: post-ramp (10m): match rate 98.9%, p95 = +45ms, 5xx = 0.15%, GPU mem at 68%. Queue depth steady. Recommend proceed to 25% in next window.

sre-oncall: minor transient spike in quant-worker-3 (cpu 88%) for 30s, auto-recovered. Keeping rollback triggers active.

megan: planning ramp to 25% at 04:00 UTC (+45m) pending no regressions. Please note: if semantic match drifts near 98% we consider canary rollback instead of full disable to investigate.

david: /approve ramp to 25%.

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_quantize_enable` -> 25% by david at 04:00 UTC.

carmen: post-ramp (5m): match 98.5%, p95 +70ms, occasional small 5xx spikes at 0.35%. Still within gates but trending.

megan: flagging caution  hold at 25% for extended soak (60m) and open a triage if match drops another 0.5%. Also updating release notes: "Quantized kernels enabled behind feature flag `llmroute_quantize_enable`. Gradual rollout with semantic match checks; fast-disable commands in runbook."

david: release notes updated and changelog pinned. Will open follow-up thread for next-window 75% ramp. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
